title: Caption Lab | CPU captioning · Operations

options.content:
### CPU image captioning · Ubuntu VM  |  5 s refresh
**01 Health → 02 Workload → 03 Latency → 04 VM resources → 05 Inputs and alerts.** Blue = single/primary, orange dashed = bulk/secondary, vermilion = errors. All trend plots use **Time** on X and a labeled **linear** Y axis. Current numbers are live; blank latency after idle means no observations, not zero seconds.

panels.title: Caption exporter
panels.description: Prometheus scrape of backend /metrics; no sample means UNKNOWN, not UP.

panels.title: BLIP model
panels.description: Loaded and ready for CPU inference; independent from exporter reachability.

panels.title: Ubuntu node
panels.description: node_exporter scrape state for VM CPU, memory and disk metrics.

panels.title: Active bulk jobs
panels.description: Accepted bulk ZIP jobs still running, including CPU lock wait.

options.content: **What is the app doing?** Images per minute show the recent processing rate (2-minute average). Totals and outcomes show events **since backend start**; they reset if it restarts. Trend axes: **Time →** and **images/minute or active jobs ↑ (linear)**.

panels.title: Successful image throughput
panels.description: Recent successful images per minute; blue solid = Single, orange dashed = Bulk. Two-minute rate reduces scrape noise.

panels.title: Image attempts · since backend start
panels.description: Single and Bulk image attempts by outcome; these are cumulative counters, not a rate.

panels.title: Jobs in progress
panels.description: Step lines show current accepted Single and Bulk jobs; a bulk job is one ZIP, even when it contains many images.

panels.title: Completed jobs · outcomes
panels.description: Jobs completed since backend start; partial means a ZIP had both successful and failed image members.

options.content: **How long does work take?** Mean and p95 come from the inference Histogram; p95 is an estimate. Per-image time includes decoding and queue wait. Job time is the full Single or ZIP request. Trend axes: **Time →; seconds/image or seconds/job ↑ (linear)**; lines have distinct dashes and markers.

panels.title: Model inference · mean & p95
panels.description: Histogram of model.generate wall time. Mean = rate(sum)/rate(count); p95 interpolates cumulative histogram buckets. No new images gives a gap.

panels.title: User-visible image time
panels.description: Mean decode + queue + inference time per image; compare Single (solid) and Bulk (dashed).

panels.title: Whole job time · Summary mean
panels.description: Full accepted request duration by mode. One bulk ZIP is one Summary observation, not one per image.

panels.title: Caption length · Summary mean
panels.description: Mean characters per successful caption over the last five minutes; length is not a quality score.

options.content: **Does bulk captioning load the VM?** Orange **bars** mark accepted bulk jobs on the **right count axis**; blue and purple lines show CPU and memory on the **left percent axis**. Align time peaks, but remember other VM processes also use resources. Trend X-axis: **Time →**; both Y-axes are **linear**.

panels.title: VM CPU ↔ bulk workload
panels.description: Blue line = average non-idle VM CPU percentage across cores (one-minute rate). Orange bars = active bulk jobs, right axis; compare peaks in time.

panels.title: VM RAM ↔ bulk workload
panels.description: Purple line = VM RAM used, calculated from MemAvailable/MemTotal. Orange bars = accepted bulk jobs on the right count axis.

panels.title: Backend RSS vs model weights
panels.description: Process resident memory includes model and runtime. Model weight bytes are a reference value, not the full process footprint.

panels.title: Backend CPU
panels.description: Process CPU uses one core as 100%, so values can exceed 100% when inference uses multiple VM cores.

panels.title: Ubuntu root disk used
panels.description: Filesystem / on the Ubuntu guest. The warning colors mark 70% and 85% used; not Mac storage.

options.content: **Who sent what?** Blue Single and orange Bulk retain the same meaning. Input byte rate measures accepted uploads; the image-size Summary measures the encoded image members. Client labels are shortened session IDs. Trend axes: **Time →; bytes/s ↑ (linear)**.

panels.title: Incoming uploads
panels.description: Accepted uploaded bytes per second by mode, two-minute average; a ZIP counts compressed request bytes here.

panels.title: Encoded image size · Summary mean
panels.description: Mean uncompressed encoded bytes per image member over five minutes; ZIP overhead is excluded.

panels.title: Top client sessions
panels.description: Successful images by shortened client session ID, cumulative since backend start; labels identify sessions, not people.

panels.title: Rejected uploads
panels.description: Rejected malformed/oversize requests since backend start; zero means none recorded.

panels.title: Images in last ZIP
panels.description: Number of image members in the last accepted bulk job; retained until another ZIP is processed.

options.content: **Can we spot and report an outage?** The timeline shows observed UP/DOWN states over time; blank segments are missing samples. The alert count is Prometheus firing rules, while Alertmanager sends notifications to the local webhook. X-axis: **Time**.

panels.title: Availability timeline
panels.description: Exporter scrape UP and model-ready state over the selected time range. Gaps mean missing samples, not healthy service.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Current Prometheus firing alerts. Confirm real notification delivery separately in evidence/logs/alerts.jsonl.

description: DA3408 A4: CPU-only captioning, workload, latency, Ubuntu node resources and local alerts. Accessible color and explicit units.
